A '''garbage atomizer''' was used for waste disposal. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Brahle Logris]] used a garbage atomizer to dispose of the weapon he used to kill [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Walads]], along with a [[Waiter/Legends|waiter's]] disguise.
